# Analyze the THREE_QUARTER peak continuation d122-d152 (what I missed while broke)

peak_missed = trips[(trips['fished_date_doy'] >= 122) & (trips['fished_date_doy'] <= 152) & (trips['cls'] == 'three_quarter')]

# Daily summary
daily = peak_missed.groupby('fished_date_doy').agg({
    'yt': 'sum',

}).rename(columns={'yt': 'total_yt', 'landing': 'num_trips'})
